question: What meditation of Cāmuṇḍā, whose name is split, is declared as difficult to obtain?
premises: Cāmuṇḍā is named with split name.
inference: The verse announces a rare meditation on Cāmuṇḍā.
uncertainties: Exact sense of bheditānāmnī remains uncertain.
plain_english: I shall declare the difficult-to-obtain meditation of Cāmuṇḍā, whose name is split.
